data.name: Entry name (optional)
data.address: Nuki bridge hostname or IP address

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Nuki device
reconfigure.description: Change the bridge address, e.g. after it got a new IP address. Leave a token blank to keep the current one.

data.address: Nuki bridge hostname or IP address
data.token: New bridge API token (blank: keep the current one)
data.web_token: New Web API token (blank: keep the current one)

error.invalid_web_token: Error communicating with Nuki Web API
error.no_token: Either Bridge token or Web API token is required
error.https_not_supported: Bridge doesn't support HTTPS callbacks. Please make your Home Assistant accessible via HTTP
error.different_bridge: This is a different Nuki bridge. Add it as a new entry instead.

data.token: Bridge API token (change it here after renewing it in the Nuki app)
data.use_hashed: Use hashed bridge token (recommended: the token is never sent in plain text; the bridge needs internet access for its clock)

error.hashed_token_rejected: The bridge rejected the hashed token. Hashed tokens need a correct bridge clock, which the bridge gets via the internet.
